metadata._comment: QUARANTINE NOTICE. These packets are the blinded input to the C3 PoC renderer and judge (docs/design/DS_C3_POC.md). The ground-truth labels live in KEY.json in this same directory and MUST NOT be read by any agent that renders or judges these packets -- doing so voids the blinding and the run. Nothing in this file says which packets are real and which are controls.
metadata.space: bias-free k(phi) -- the first 128 coordinates of C0's homogeneous e_q; cosines below are MEAN-REMOVED (the bank mean direction is subtracted from both sides before the cosine)
